parts.label: (a)
parts.question_text:
A metal wire has a resistance per unit length of 0.92 Ω m^{-1}. The wire has a uniform
cross‑sectional area of 5.3 × 10^{-7} m^{2}.
Calculate the resistivity of the metal of the wire.
resistivity = Ω m

cross‑sectional area of $5.3 \times 10^{-7}\,\mathrm{m}^{2}$.
